official_mandate: As per eNAM guidelines and APMC Model Act 2017, commission/market fee is payable SOLELY by the buyer/trader. No commission can be deducted from the farmer's gross proceeds.
spoken_summary_hi: eNAM aur APMC niyam ke mutabik, aadhitiya ka koi bhi commission kisan ke paise se nahi kat sakta. Commission hamesha khareedne wala vyapari deta hai.
actionable_advice: If an arhtiya deducts 2-6% commission, ask for the formal APMC receipt and report it to the Mandi Secretary office.

official_mandate: All produce traded under eNAM must be weighed on electronic, calibrated weighbridges. Weighment charges (Hamali/Tolao) are regulated by the APMC (typically ₹10-₹15 per quintal).
spoken_summary_hi: Maal ki tulai hamesha computerized kanta par hi karayein aur computer wali kanta parchi zaroor lein. Manmani katauti gair-kanooni hai.
actionable_advice: Never accept visual estimation or manual uncalibrated beam scales.

official_mandate: Every eNAM integrated mandi is equipped with a quality assaying laboratory. Farmers are entitled to have moisture, size, and foreign matter tested objectively before auction.
spoken_summary_hi: Mandi me sarkari laboratory hoti hai jahan fasal ki quality aur nami (moisture) ki jaanch muft hoti hai. Isse vyapari aapki fasal ko bekar bata kar daam nahi gira sakta.
actionable_advice: Get an assaying certificate before the bidding starts to lock in Fair Average Quality (FAQ) pricing.

official_mandate: Payments for eNAM bids are settled directly through the eNAM clearing house into the farmer's bank account on the same day or within 24 hours.
spoken_summary_hi: eNAM par bikri ka paisa seedha aapke bank khate me aana chahiye, kisi kache parchi ya lambe udhar par maal na dein.
actionable_advice: Keep your Aadhaar-linked bank account number handy for direct settlement.
